configuration.dataMaskingIntro: One setting for the app and Snowflake. The columns ticked below are personal data: they are masked in the MDM screens, in Cortex Analyst, the agent, analytics views and published golden records — for every user whose Snowflake role is not listed under 'Roles that see PII in clear'. Each user's Snowflake role is set in Security › Users.
configuration.piiUnmaskRoles: Roles that see PII in clear
configuration.piiAlwaysClear: ACCOUNTADMIN and MDM_SERVICE_ROLE always see clear values. Role hierarchy applies: a role granted a selected role also sees clear values.
configuration.piiSaved: Masking roles saved and synced to Snowflake
configuration.piiColumnsHint: Masked in API responses and tagged PII_TYPE on the Snowflake views. Emails keep their domain; other values keep the last 4 characters.
configuration.piiUserAccessHint: Saved settings. A user sees PII in clear when their Snowflake role, or a role it inherits, is selected above. Users without a Snowflake role always see masked values.
configuration.piiUsersNote: The Snowflake role set for each user also decides whether they see personal data in clear, in the app and in Cortex Analyst.
configuration.piiRolesNote: These are business roles for workflows and permissions in the app. Access to personal data follows each user's Snowflake role instead.
configuration.moduleSyncHelp: Views, history tables, policies, PUBLISH views and the semantic view are rebuilt automatically after every module or field change.
